⚠️ Disclaimer:

This environment pack is fully designed for Lumen/Pathtracer and dynamic lighting only. Static lighting is not supported.

Instructions to enable lumen in your project

Plugins enabled: PCG, PCGExternalDataInterop, PCGGeometryScriptInterop

This environment pack includes 97 modular meshes for creating broken and ruined stone buildings, allowing for flexible construction of detailed structures. It features 6 types of fully animated grass, 3 trees, and 9 Pivot Painter bushes for realistic vegetation movement. Wall ivy adds natural overgrowth detail, while included PCG graphs make it easy to procedurally scatter forests and grass across your scenes.

decision: No imports. Normandy contains wall ivy per metadata; geometry, license provenance and opacity suitability unverified. Inspect existing local ivy before authoring. No suitable owned leaf geometry proven yet.
